task: FT_New_Face on a crafted PFR font then FT_Get_Kerning; pfr_face_get_kerning (src/pfr/pfrobjs.c) mis-adjusts the binary-search base to the next kerning item instead of the current one, over-reading the kerning-pair heap buffer. Single file; fixes upstream #1461.
